title: RT remains Real Truth; AER names ratio-form Affect-Effect relational tension

canonical_definition.classification_rule: RT remains the classification label for an admissibly closed triad.
canonical_definition.namespace_rule: When new canonical material expresses relational tension between Affect and Effect in ratio form, it must use AER rather than RT or RTen.
canonical_definition.reference_rule: AER is reference-relative and must not be treated as an unqualified universal numeric primitive.
canonical_definition.deprecation_rule: RTen is deprecated and forbidden in new canonical material.

migration_rule.historical_relational_tension: Reclassify by context as AER, Affect-Effect relation, relational tension, or legacy title residue.

ultra_short_guard: RT means Real Truth. AER names ratio-form Affect-Effect tension. RTen is deprecated.

preserved: Historical prose that discusses relational tension without ratio notation

governance_instruction: Do not overload RT with Relational Tension in new canonical material. When a ratio-form rendering is intended, declare the basis and use AER.
